text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the final stretch! Who will seize the 
glory of the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...*Pant*, *gasp*... *Pant*... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(...It hurts. It's suffocating. It's so 
hard, I want to stop. I can't take any 
more of this. My lungs feel like they're 
going to burst—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Forward, forward... keep moving 
forward...!! Hyaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No! I will take the lead!! This race, this 
Derby is where my name will be... etched!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I don't want to.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to lose, I don't want to 
lose, I don't want to lose! This is my 
Derby!! Mine and Maruzen-san's—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It's the Derbyyyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I could entrust it to you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I won.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I... I really won the Derby...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Trainer... Um, I gave it 
everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My spirit, my sweat, every last bit... I 
gave it everything my body had, poured it 
all out, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"They won't stop... my tears. This feeling 
of happiness... Trainer, I..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I've become a Derby Umamusume...!!
(Woooooaaaaahhhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …………Ah, I really wanted to surpass you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...And here I thought today, this very 
moment, was my one and only chance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... I was a part of this current 
scenery too..."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O-san! Congratulations on 
your Derby victory!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Watching her run while wringing out every 
last ounce of willpower right to the very 
end—that truly was a magnificent display 
of pure guts!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because... I just didn't want to lose 
no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Because it was today's Derby. Because 
there was someone I just couldn't bear to 
lose to.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Because that was my Derby, the one I 
promised to her.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this turned out to be a race 
packed with so many feelings.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, would you please share a few 
words with the audience who witnessed that 
match!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!! Um, I, Sakura Chiyono O, will 
continue to...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very best so as not to bring 
shame to the title of Derby Umamusume!!
(Wooooo!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Chiyo-chan. You are a magnificent, 
top-notch Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, next time, let's fulfill that 
final promise with you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Let us run together. ...And please accept 
this gift from me."

Surrounded by the cheers of the massive 
crowd, today's newly crowned Derby 
Umamusume, Sakura Chiyono O, waves with 
both hands.

In the long-awaited place she had dreamed 
of all along—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Wait up.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Don't let it end in such an "ordinary" 
way.

On the night of the Nippon Derby, Sakura 
Chiyono O and the others delivered their 
gratitude to the gathered crowd through 
their Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Run through the present, it's not over 
yet 'Cause there's a place I want to 
reach... ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... You're right. Especially about 
the "right now" part.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I realized something. Where I first 
started from... was simply 'I want to win 
the Derby.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after Maruzen-san, receiving 
Maruzen-san's feelings... That's why I 
want to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But before I knew it, "I don't want to 
lose" was added to that. That feeling gave 
my legs strength, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The moment I crossed the finish line at 
the end... I found myself wishing that 
this time would never end."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep competing forever, as 
their rival. I want to keep running on and 
on, forever and ever."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Having a rival really is an amazing 
thing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, alright! Now, what shall we do next?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now that the major goal of the Derby is 
behind her, what should a Derby Umamusume 
challenge next—the Kikuka Sho, or the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)—?
(SLAM!!)

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
A-An ambulance!! Hurry!! Someone over 
there, please grab a stretcher!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san has... Mejiro Ardan has 
collapsed!!"

After the concert, the wail of an 
ambulance suddenly echoed out.

Sakura Chiyono O turned pale as a sheet, 
holding Mejiro Ardan's hand and 
continually calling out to her as she was 
carried away to the hospital on a 
stretcher.

Having received those words of 
encouragement, Mejiro Ardan, her face 
still beaded with sweat, clasped the 
offered hand in return ...and gave a 
satisfied smile.
And a few days later—

The results of the detailed examination 
revealed that, due to the strain she had 
put on them until now, Mejiro Ardan's legs 
had become extremely fragile.

Her life became a cycle of hospital visits 
and admissions for treatment... and it 
seems there is still no clear prospect of 
her returning to the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...You came to visit me in the hospital, 
didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ardan-san. Um... well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Please, don't tense up so much. I was 
fully prepared for this price."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And this is also a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because I was frail, I was far more 
sensitive to my own body than others. 
...To my limits, as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Before I even realized it, being conscious 
of that was eating away at me. Whispering 
that I shouldn't go any further, that I 
must never step beyond this line.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Still, seeing you say you'd defy 
"normalcy," seeing you struggle against 
what was given to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am ready to pour my entire soul into 
racing you. I was able to touch what lies 
beyond my limits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"And since I was able to witness that 
miracle, I have no regrets left in this 
world."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... Does that mean......!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Preparations are already underway.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No way...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Chiyono O. From now on, you are sure 
to face many new rivals."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However, please remember that Mejiro 
Ardan was among them. Remember that there 
was an Umamusume who defied fate and 
sought to shine with all her might."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I won't forget. I will never forget.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So please don't forget, Ardan-san. That 
you have a rival in me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I swear I will make you regret this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Rivals are amazing, you know? Whenever you 
feel that urge not to lose to them, you 
can draw out dozens of times more strength 
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Right before the Derby's finish line. 
Surely you must have felt it too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"So even if you have no regrets now, as 
long as I remain in your heart as your 
rival."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You'll surely want to compete with those 
legs again. You'll want to challenge each 
other once more...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'll make sure to become your 
biggest regret. When that time comes, 
let's race again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then.
choice_data_list: Do you really have no regrets at all?
Do you truly have no regrets at all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ......Yes, with no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you just tell me that you have no 
regrets...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I'm going to get much, much 
stronger, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even when we fight next time, I won't 
lose...!

Holding back her tears, Sakura Chiyono O 
trembled. She had gained yet another layer 
of strength.
